title: Verbal Aspect in Past Tense
description: Aspect choice in past tense narratives
intro: Building on A2 aspect pairs and the B1 Aspect Deep Dive, this lesson focuses on aspect in past tense narratives. Aspect choice shapes how events are presented. Imperfective past sets the SCENE or BACKGROUND (Светило солнце - The sun was shining). Perfective past advances the PLOT with completed events (Он вошёл - He entered). When telling stories, use imperfective for ongoing situations and perfective for the sequence of events. This is like English 'was doing' (background) vs 'did' (event), but Russian aspect carries even more meaning about how you view the action.
rules: Background/scene-setting uses imperfective: Шёл дождь. Люди спешили домой. (It was raining. People were hurrying home.)
Sequential plot events use perfective: Он встал, оделся и вышел. (He got up, dressed, and went out.)
Simultaneous background actions use imperfective: Пока она готовила, он читал. (While she cooked, he read.)
Interrupted action: imperfective (ongoing) + perfective (interruption): Я читал, когда он пришёл. (I was reading when he arrived.)
examples: Было тепло. Дети играли в парке. (It was warm. Children were playing in the park.), background
Вдруг раздался гром. Все побежали домой. (Suddenly thunder sounded. Everyone ran home.), plot events
Я смотрел телевизор, когда позвонил телефон. (I was watching TV when the phone rang.), interrupted
Он встал, умылся и позавтракал. (He got up, washed, and had breakfast.), sequence

items.prompt: _____ солнце. Птицы пели. (The sun was shining. Birds were singing.) - scene
items.promptEnglish: The sun was shining. Birds were singing.

items.prompt: Он _____, оделся и вышел из дома. (He got up, dressed, and left the house.)
items.promptEnglish: He got up, dressed, and left the house.
items.explanation: Sequence of plot events uses perfective: встал.

items.prompt: Дети _____ в саду, когда начался дождь. (Children were playing in the garden when the rain started.)
items.promptEnglish: Children were playing when the rain started.
items.hint: Ongoing action interrupted by another event → imperfective

items.prompt: Пока мама _____, папа смотрел телевизор. (While mom was cooking, dad watched TV.)
items.promptEnglish: While mom was cooking, dad watched TV.
items.explanation: Simultaneous action with 'пока' uses imperfective: готовила.

items.prompt: Вдруг дверь _____ и вошёл незнакомец. (Suddenly the door opened and a stranger entered.)
items.promptEnglish: Suddenly the door opened and a stranger entered.
items.explanation: Sudden event with 'вдруг' uses perfective: открылась.

items.prompt: Я _____ книгу, когда зазвонил телефон. (I was reading a book when the phone rang.)
items.promptEnglish: I was reading when the phone rang.
items.explanation: Interrupted ongoing action uses imperfective: читал.

items.prompt: Она _____ письмо, _____ его в конверт и отправила. (She wrote the letter, put it in an envelope, and sent it.)
items.promptEnglish: She wrote the letter, put it in an envelope, and sent it.
items.hint: Chain of completed actions → all perfective
items.explanation: Sequential completed actions all use perfective: написала, положила.

items.prompt: В детстве я часто _____ к бабушке. (In childhood I often went to grandma's.)
items.promptEnglish: In childhood I often went to grandma's.
items.explanation: Repeated action with 'часто' uses imperfective: ходил.

items.prompt: Он _____ газету и вдруг увидел знакомое имя. (He was reading the newspaper and suddenly saw a familiar name.)
items.promptEnglish: He was reading the newspaper and suddenly saw a familiar name.
items.hint: Background action before sudden event → imperfective
items.explanation: Ongoing background before 'вдруг' event uses imperfective: читал.

blanks: Когда я _____ домой, начался дождь. (When I was walking home, the rain started. - female speaker)
Дети играли в парке, когда _____ мама. (The children were playing when mom arrived.)
Он _____ газету и лёг спать. (He read the newspaper and went to bed.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Ongoing action interrupted → imperfective; completed actions → perfective
hints: The 'когда' clause describes ongoing motion that was interrupted. Which verb shows ongoing walking?
Mom's arrival interrupted the playing: a single completed event. Which aspect?
He finished reading then went to bed: a completed sequence. Which aspect?
explanations: An ongoing background action uses imperfective past: шла (was walking).
A single interrupting event uses perfective: пришла (arrived, completed).
Sequential completed actions use perfective: прочитал (read and finished).

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ письмо весь вечер. (all evening - duration)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He wrote the letter all evening.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ письмо и пошёл на почту. (wrote and then went - sequence)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He wrote the letter and went to the post office.
minimalPairs.explanation: Completed action in sequence requires perfective: написал.
